# 3D models

## Speaker (`speaker.json`)
Baked from "Speaker Welder Part" by Elite Big Speakerman
(https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/speaker-welder-part-98e6fe3b5cc0441bb03d8f41487be2c2),
licensed CC BY 4.0 (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
Changes: geometry quantised and scaled, base colour and emissive textures reduced, other textures dropped.

## Flat cap (`hats.json`, key `flatcap`)
Baked from "Flat Cap" by Fridge
(https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/flat-cap-bd196ab9e2d8441798177839b9e66e09),
licensed CC BY 4.0 (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
Changes: geometry quantised, scaled and fitted to the character's head; base colour texture reduced
and tinted red; other textures dropped.

## Cap (`hats.json`, key `cap`)
Baked from "Cap" by KaramellGlass
(https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/cap-3a3bb4aa2e284e98b9f761defc6a8f4a),
licensed CC BY 4.0 (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
Changes: geometry quantised, scaled and fitted to the character's head; base colour texture reduced;
other textures dropped.

## Stage light (`stagelight.json`)
Baked from "Stage Light - Fresnel" by Mike Rowley
(https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/stage-light-fresnel-3554154c724c4cf1b8db4ff26f65b54c),
licensed CC BY-NC 4.0 (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/) - non-commercial use only.
Changes: geometry quantised, scaled and re-oriented; the lens texture dropped.

## Push button (`button.json`)
Baked from "Button" by DrakonSlayer
https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/button-dfff87207b394ded97a7c7c2669a5fe1
Licence: CC BY 4.0 (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
Changes: only the two shapes (base ring and cap) are kept, as 16-bit positions; its textures are replaced by ones painted in the room
(coloured caps with labels, and a ring that lights as an indicator). Made by `tools/make_button.py`.

# Fonts (`public/fonts/`)
Anton by Vernon Adams and Kaushan Script by Pablo Impallari, used for the lobby. Both are under the SIL Open Font Licence 1.1. Files taken from the Fontsource packages.

Pixel Game by suhadidesign and Merchant Copy by S. John Ross, supplied by the project owner for the two-screen menu (`pixelgame.otf`, `merchantcopy.ttf`).
Pixel Game's own file is marked "For Personal Use Only": a licence from the maker is needed before a public release.
